propositions: Four hand-built LLM sub-calls bypass model-class configuration by passing raw cfg instead of class-selected config, routing calls to direct Anthropic that should route through Bedrock.
overlap-judge dominates plan-review traffic with 18 of 23 calls going to Anthropic instead of the configured Bedrock provider when a class table is configured but cfg.model remains bare.
ticket-digest runs on the store write path (_store/event_append and _store/push) during routine rebar comment/create operations, sending ticket content to Anthropic with no gate visibility.
Three of four bypass sites (ticket-digest, overlap-judge, code-novelty) must select models from the class vocabulary with documented reasoning rather than inheriting cfg.model.

A regression test using model-class configuration distinct from cfg.model must verify no hand-built sub-call resolves to cfg.model, and a general AST provenance analysis must prevent new bypassing calls from being added silently.
